dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Unitask task, tag, settings, and time-block management, and the listed read, write, move, merge, and soft-delete capabilities fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Unitask workflows and include least-privilege token guidance, dry-run defaults for compound actions, and confirmation guidance for deletes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown and metadata only; setup configures a hosted HTTPS MCP endpoint and a UNITASK_API_KEY secret, with no bundled executable installer or local scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires a Unitask bearer token, which is expected for account access; the artifacts tell users to store it in a secret store and not paste full tokens into chat.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can persist changes in the user's Unitask account, including task updates, tag changes, settings updates, time-block application, and soft deletion, but these powers are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an AI agent to manage your Unitask account. Create the narrowest token scopes you need, store the API key in your client or agent secret store, and review write, delete, merge, move, or apply actions before letting the agent perform them.
llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed Unitask account integration that lets an agent read and change tasks using a scoped API token.
